WITH major_counts AS (
    SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member
    GROUP BY link_to_major
)
SELECT major_id,
       member_count,
       1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total
FROM major_counts
ORDER BY fraction_of_total DESC
LIMIT 10;
